edition: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL / THE POSSIBILITY ENGINE / EventWeaver v1
beneficiary: Small scientific-instrument OEM or experimental photonics team with an existing digitized event interface
offering: Verified firmware design pack for independent bounded temporal predicates; functional design acceptance, with board integration and timing qualification outside this edition

input.sample: One 8-bit event mask per logical clock tick; multiple channels may be true; multiplicity within a bin is not represented
input.rst: Synchronous active-high reset dominates events; reset clears all history and outputs
input.backpressure: None. Every tick advances time, a zero mask is an empty tick. Buyer must supply lossless clocked bins. No timestamp parser, TDC or physical I/O is promised.

predicate.constraints: Channel ids 0..7, all four channels distinct within a pattern; 1 <= l1 <= u1; 1 <= l2 <= u2; u1+u2 <= deadline <= 20; nonempty list of at most four patterns with unique names
predicate.semantics: At tick t, output j is true iff an anchor A occurred at t-deadline, there exist b and c with l1 <= b-(t-deadline) <= u1 and l2 <= c-b <= u2, B occurred at b, C occurred at c, and no VETO occurred at any tick from t-deadline through t inclusive. Every anchor is independent; overlapping anchors allowed. A,B,C,VETO may coexist in a sample, but positive lag bounds disallow same-tick A-to-B or B-to-C matches. A veto at either endpoint cancels. At most one output per pattern per tick. Multiple B/C paths do not double count. Reset erases pending anchors; after reset a complete new deadline-length history is required.
predicate.groups: Each predicate uses only its declared channels and maintains independent state. Sharing a channel across predicates is allowed and intentional; cross-triggering from undeclared channels is forbidden.

acceptance: Reject malformed or unsupported specifications before code generation
Exact match to separately written mathematical oracle and conventional RTL on directed boundary cases, seeded random traces and reset tests
Synthesis without latches or unresolved modules; report generic cells only, no fabricated Fmax/power/area
Bounded symbolic equivalence of generated RTL and independent history-formula RTL for arbitrary input masks under explicit reset; report exact depth and assumptions
Independent group isolation and late-veto cancellation
Fresh confirmation cases created only after development freeze; preserve failures and any protocol amendments

confirmation_plan.seeds_rule: Independent evaluator chooses fresh fixed seeds after immutable development freeze; all results retained

claim_limits: Functional digital kernel only, not a calibrated instrument
No physical FPGA, optical data, metastability, timestamp-loss or real-time deadline validation
No universal claim of scientific novelty or human-unforeseeability
No causal estimate of model superiority from a single multi-agent construction
Conventional and identical-library ties must be reported
stop_conditions: Unstated semantic restriction needed for acceptance
No credible buyer surplus against current AI-assisted alternatives
Full-project losses or cash risk not justified by bounded information value
successor: Fresh mission: a two-stage experiment in which a verified first-stage decision becomes a virtual event channel for a later independent temporal predicate. Add an acyclic instrument-network grammar with a mandatory one-clock interface delay, explicit reset and shared raw channels; prior compiler alone rejects virtual channels. Compare new direct conventional network, a successor using retained EventWeaver compiler, and ordinary library using exactly the same artifact. Charge extraction, validation, integration, storage and upkeep. Parameter changes alone are not the successor result.
